title.zh: Kalshi joins Coinbase with filing for US stock perpetual futures
title.en: Kalshi joins Coinbase with filing for US stock perpetual futures

current_state.zh: Kalshi has filed with the SEC and CFTC to offer perpetual futures tied to individual US stocks, joining Coinbase and Bitnomial in bringing crypto-style perpetual derivatives to traditional equity markets.
current_state.en: Kalshi has filed with the SEC and CFTC to offer perpetual futures tied to individual US stocks, joining Coinbase and Bitnomial in bringing crypto-style perpetual derivatives to traditional equity markets.
